colour/ink.text: A warm off-white page where all the text, lines and buttons are set in one deep brand colour instead of black: confident, crafted and distinctive

composition/split.text: The screen split into two halves all the way down: words on one side, a full-height photo on the other, swapping sides as you scroll. Balanced and modern.

type/heritage.text: A warm, chunky old-style serif with a plain sans-serif: friendly, characterful and a little nostalgic, like a traditional shop sign

type/couture.text: A soft, high-contrast serif with a clean modern sans-serif: refined, feminine and quietly luxurious, like a fashion label

detail/stamp.text: A round, slightly tilted stamp on the main photo with the year the business opened and its neighbourhood: playful, human and local

hero/colour.text: Opens with a big headline set on a solid block of the brand colour, the photo cut into a soft rounded shape beside it: bold, warm and graphic

colour/vivid.text: The whole page in the bright brand colour itself, with near-black text and deep colour bands: bold, joyful and loud

composition/column.text: Like a magazine article: one narrow column of text with small labels in the margin, and photos that break out to the edge of the page. Calm, considered and literate.

composition/index.text: Organised like a catalogue or timetable: rows divided by thin lines, small photos with captions, prices and hours as clear tables. Precise, informative and efficient.

type/wide.text: Very wide, bold letters with small typewriter-style labels: loud, energetic and fashion-forward, made to stand out

detail/numbers.text: A row of a few big numbers right after the opening, such as the year it opened and the number of reviews: factual, proud and reassuring

detail/strip.text: A thin coloured strip across the very top of the page with the opening days, the late night and a booking link: practical, lively and welcoming

hero/photo.text: Opens with one full-screen photo of the real place and just the business name on it, no slogan: confident, quiet and atmospheric

colour/paper.text: A light, warm off-white page with dark text, the brand colour used only for buttons and small accents: quiet and neutral

detail/monogram.text: A round monogram with the business's initials, like a maker's mark, on the main photo: crafted, classic and personal

type/grotesk.text: A heavy, tightly spaced sans-serif: direct, confident and modern, plain-speaking with no decoration

type/condensed.text: Tall, narrow capital letters with a sturdy slab serif for reading: rugged, no-nonsense and traditional, like a barber or a workshop sign

colour/deep.text: The whole page in a deep, dark version of the brand colour with cream text: rich, moody and luxurious, like an evening venue

type/inscription.text: Carved, classical letters like a stone inscription, with a gentle book serif: serene, natural and timeless, like a spa or an apothecary

type/gallery.text: A light, classical serif set large with a crisp sans-serif: calm, cultured and upmarket, like a gallery or a fine hotel

composition/monument.text: The business name set enormous across the full width of the page, above a wide photo, with everything else small and aligned to a strict grid. Bold and graphic.

type/friendly.text: A round, chunky sans-serif with a relaxed modern text face: cheerful, welcoming and affordable, for everyone

composition/bands.text: Full-width bands one after another: a full-screen photo opening with the headline on it, then alternating bands of colour, text and edge-to-edge photos. Immersive and rich.

composition/framed.text: Symmetrical and centred, like an invitation: centred headings, photos in arched frames, thin ornamental dividers between sections. Graceful, classic and upmarket.

hero/native.text: Opens with the headline and a photo arranged by the page layout itself: balanced and informative

photo/lowkey.text: Moody, atmospheric photos with low warm light and deep shadows, slightly darkened and warmed: cinematic, intimate and premium

hero/quiet.text: Opens with one atmospheric full-screen photo, a single short line of small refined type in the middle and one understated button: calm, premium and confident

detail/none.text: No decorative extras at all, nothing but the essentials: restrained, quiet and minimal

colour/night.text: A near-black page with soft cream text and the brand colour only as a small accent: dark, cinematic and exclusive, like a members club at night

photo/natural.text: Bright, natural, everyday photos shown as they are: open, honest and friendly

photo/portrait.text: Opens on a moody, atmospheric portrait of a person in low warm light, the rest of the photos darkened and warmed to match: intimate, personal and editorial

colour/cream.text: A warm cream page with near-black text, the brand colour on buttons, small accents and one deep colour band: calm, warm and quietly expensive
